motivation: Descriptive OOF diagnostics found calendar residual differences, particularly application month. This motivated a hypothesis; it does not provide an unbiased test or establish causality.
encoding: One-hot month/year fitted on outer training; unpenalized intercept and L2-penalized category coefficients
training: Use the matching-fold spline's in-sample outer-training probabilities as a frozen logistic offset. Fit calendar coefficients using all 56,000 outer-training labels only. The spline itself also excludes outer validation. This is another training stage, not stacking predictions from other OOF folds.
prediction: Transfer the learned calendar log-odds adjustment, with strength 0.5 or 1.0, onto logit(0.75*frozen_Kumo + 0.25*spline) for this fold's validation/test. Remove the balanced-loss prior shift from the output.
audit: Check source model/train/validation hashes, recompute the training objective gradient, rebuild all OOF/test probabilities and compute full-five-fold KS. No outer-validation label is a fitting input.
selection_limitations: Feature hypotheses and repeated model selection use training labels and OOF diagnostics. These reused splits are not an untouched holdout; results may be optimistic.
